name: Ward Mountain Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234207 (199 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: Humboldt-Toiyabe NF (Ely RD), Ward Mtn Rec Area (Murray Summit) ~10 mi SW of Ely at ~7,400 ft. 33 sites including back-in and 3 pull-thru RV sites; vault toilets, drinking water, trash service, no hookups. Amphitheater, volleyball, horseshoe pit. Reservable in peak season (~mid-May-late Sept). Paved/graded access off US-6/50/93. --Claude

name: Tusayan - Montane Campground (formerly Ten-X, Kaibab National Forest)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234488 (141 days observed, edges opens)
note: USFS campground (renamed from Ten-X) in the Kaibab NF ponderosa forest ~2 mi south of Tusayan/Grand Canyon, ~70 sites. Pull-through sites accommodate up to 35 ft and back-in/parallel sites up to 34-38 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits. Reservable on Recreation.gov with some FCFS. --Claude

name: Jacob Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234529 (149 days observed, edges closes)
note: Kaibab NF (North Kaibab RD) campground at the US-89A/AZ-67 junction, ~44 mi N of Grand Canyon North Rim, in ponderosa pine at ~7,900 ft. 51 single sites (Loop LOPA) plus 2 group sites; no hookups, drinking water and vault/flush toilets. Single sites take tents/trailers/small motorhomes (no posted max, 14-day limit); group sites are 60-100 ft pull-throughs. Reservable online; season ~May 15-Oct 15. --Claude

name: Burro Creek Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 10000305 (264 days observed, edges closes+opens)
note: BLM Kingman Field Office campground on a bench above Burro Creek, ~1.5 mi off US-93 (paved access) ~1 mi S of Burro Creek Bridge. 23 individual sites + 1 group + 2 day-use. Sites 1, 2 and 10-17 best for larger Class A/fifth-wheels. Group and sites 7,9,10-17 reservable online, rest FCFS. --Claude

name: Kaibab Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233957 (149 days observed, edges closes)
note: Kaibab NF (Williams RD), on Kaibab Lake ~3 mi N of Williams off AZ-64. ~73 sites incl 3 group areas, potable water (not for filling RV tanks). Mix of reservable and walk-up FCFS sites; open ~late Apr-Oct, weather permitting. Fishing pier and small boat ramp on the lake. --Claude

name: Canyon Point Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232193 (171 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: Apache-Sitgreaves NF, on AZ-260 (MP287) near Forest Lakes atop the Mogollon Rim. 113 sites, 32 with electric hookups, restrooms plus a dump station (8am-5pm). Mix of reservable and FCFS. About 5 mi from Willow Springs Lake. --Claude

name: Rolfe C. Hoyer Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232197 (132 days observed, edges closes)
note: Apache-Sitgreaves NF, on AZ-373 ~2 mi N of Greer (~8,300 ft, White Mountains) in tall pines. ~93-100 sites on gravel roads. Mix of reservable and walk-up FCFS; mid-May-Oct. Less than a mile from the Greer Lakes and Little Colorado River (fishing). --Claude

name: Houston Mesa Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232355 (264 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: Tonto NF (Payson RD) campground ~1 mi north of Payson. 102 sites total: 46 standard, 27 equestrian, 29 tent-only; 30 sites fit RVs 20-99 ft. Reservable via recreation.gov with some FCFS. NOTE: temporarily closed for improvements through Oct 1, 2026 per Tonto NF closure order (verify reopening before booking). Elev ~5,050 ft. --Claude

name: Cholla Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 249312 (243 days observed, edges closes+opens)
note: Tonto NF campground on the NW shore of Theodore Roosevelt Lake; 206 RV/tent sites in four loops (Teddy Bear, Buckhorn, Christmas, Cane), one of the largest solar-powered campgrounds in the US. Paved boat launch. Odd-numbered sites reservable online, even-numbered FCFS. Seasonally closed ~June 1 to October (summer heat). --Claude

name: Windy Hill Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 249308 (212 days observed, edges closes)
note: Tonto NF campground on the south shore of Theodore Roosevelt Lake; 147 sites in three loops (Coati, Chipmunk, Coyote), no hookups, max trailer 32 ft except Coati Loop limited to 20 ft. Shade ramadas, vault toilets, showers, dump station, boat ramp and fishing dock. Reservable Nov 1-Mar 15, FCFS Apr 1-Oct 31. --Claude
